title: Caliburn X Replacement Pod 2ml - 2 Pack
description: This pack of Two replacement, refillable Caliburn X 2ml pods feature a top-filling design to prevent leaks. With the Caliburn X pods, you simply remove the cap to expose the fill port. The Caliburn X pods are compatible with Uwell’s G series coils, which you can swap easily for a different vaping experience. The pods work best with nic-salt, 50/50 and high PG e-liquids. The new Caliburn X vape device is Uwell’s most advanced Caliburn pod kit yet, and one that offers all the flavour, performance and ease of use that has come to define the series, but also adds several new features that make this a great vape kit, for beginners and even more experienced vapers.
